highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.159.0 adds experimental image-comparison tools and fixes runtime uniforms, texture sampling and Windows image-decoding crashes.
highlights_body: The separate SkiaSharp.Testing package supports configurable image acceptance and difference diagnostics. Linux x86 native assets are no longer packaged in this line.

breaking.title: Move away from packaged Linux x86 native assets
breaking.body: Linux x86 native binaries are no longer built or included in NuGet packages. Apps relying on those assets must move to a supported architecture when upgrading to this line.

bullets.detail: SkiaSharp.Testing adds SKImageComparison for SKImage, SKBitmap and SKPixmap, with channel tolerances, masks, mismatch budgets, error metrics and difference images. The assembly is experimental: opt in by suppressing SKIA4001 with NoWarn or a pragma. Results retain no native handles; returned difference images are caller-owned.
New SKRuntimeEffectUniforms buffers start zeroed rather than containing leftover memory. Reset clears the existing buffer in place, avoiding a native-buffer and wrapper allocation on each call.

Fixes crashes in clang-built Windows x64 natives when libjpeg or libpng recovers from decoding errors. This also fixes PDF output with lazy non-JPEG images and malformed JPEG input to SKCodec.Create. Other architectures and MSVC builds are unchanged.

Keeps bilinear samples inside texture subsets and avoids an unsafe direct-copy path at logical texture edges. Edge pixels may change; CPU and Graphite rendering are unaffected by this sampling option.

Applies the intended CPU blur configuration to Skia itself, selecting the existing ThreeBoxApprox/Tent paths instead of the shader-based Gaussian candidate. Blur pixels and performance may differ; Tizen rendering and performance were not measured in the source change.
Refreshes the bundled engine with upstream fixes within the Skia m159 milestone, without changing managed bindings.

contributor_summaries.taublast: Zero-initialized runtime-effect uniforms, allocation-free buffer reset and test snapshot disposal.
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Restored the Uno Gallery and its view projects to the Windows samples solution.
contributor_summaries.SimonCropp: Fixed Windows x64 libjpeg and libpng error-recovery crashes.
